name: deepwiki-codebase-wiki
description: Cross-platform codebase wiki generation with source-grounded documentation, architecture coverage audits, Mermaid authoring/render validation, and regression tests.

interface.longDescription: An additive ChatGPT runtime adapter for the original DeepWiki Skill. Version 2.0.8 adds a source-derived architecture map before TOC design, page-local claim/relationship evidence ledgers, and a Phase 4 semantic coverage review that reopens source files and audits diagram edges against implementation relationships. It reports structural validation, content coverage, diagram semantics, Mermaid authoring lint, and actual renderer outcomes separately. The coverage helper validates the declared manifest and does not replace source rereading.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use DeepWiki's original six-phase workflow and preserve the workflow-runner contract. Before TOC design, page writing, or validation, read references/architecture-completeness.md. Do not equate structural validity, citation count, Mermaid syntax, and content completeness. Phase 2 must inspect build manifests, entry points, implementation files, tests, and conditional/platform branches; produce _context/architecture_map.json with relevant source inventory, key symbols, directed relationships (compile inputs, includes/imports, link dependencies, runtime entry/call paths, control/data flow, lifecycle, platform/configuration branches, and test mappings where present), and page/section/diagram scope assignments. Phase 3 must create a page-local evidence ledger for critical/supporting claims and relationships, with exact source line ranges and the page location where each is explained. Build diagrams from that ledger and label edge semantics explicitly; include all critical relationships in each diagram's declared scope. Phase 4 must re-open key source files in a separate semantic review, compare actual page coverage with the architecture map, and audit every diagram's nodes, edge direction/type, platform conditions, and omissions against source. Produce _reports/architecture_coverage.json and run tools/architecture/validate_coverage.py. The helper validates the manifest structure only; it cannot discover omitted relationships or prove semantic correctness, so source rereading is mandatory. Keep structure_status, citation_status, content_coverage_status, diagram_semantic_status, Mermaid authoring status, and Mermaid renderer status separate. Any unreviewed item or coverage gap means content coverage incomplete; a critical in-scope diagram omission fails. Before Mermaid authoring, also read references/mermaid-authoring.md and references/mermaid-engine.md. Use unquoted pipe labels (A -->|Yes| B), run tools/mermaid/mermaid_lint.py --check, and repair only via --repair --output with AUTOGEN-only merge. Static lint is not parsing. Renderer is passed only after actual Mermaid.js parse plus SVG render or Mermaid CLI success; otherwise not_run. Run both packaged unittest suites when Python is available. Use native page workers only when the host genuinely supports them; otherwise report sequential fallback.
